**Gold Years Account at a glance**

## Snapshot

- Designed for customers aged 62 and older
- $0.00 monthly maintenance fee
- Earn 1.0% APY on your checking balance
- 3 complimentary personal check orders per year
- Paper statements: $0.00/month
- Out-of-network ATM withdrawal fee: $0.00
- Early direct deposit: up to 2 days early
- Mobile check deposit limit: $5,000 per day
- Prescription savings: 12.5% at partner pharmacies when you pay with your debit card
- Dedicated senior support line access: Yes
- One-time Social Security direct deposit bonus: $50.00
- Estate planning consultation discount through partner firms: 17.5%
- APY boosts on linked savings: Gold Plus +0.5%, Silver +0.6%

## Quick reference

### Source: doc_checking_accounts_gold_years_account_002
**Gold Years Account specifications and requirements**

## Eligibility
- You must be at least 62 years old to qualify.

## Fees and rates
- Monthly maintenance fee: $0.00 dollars
- Annual Percentage Yield on balances: 1.0% percent
- Out-of-network ATM withdrawal fee: $0.00 dollars
- Foreign ATM withdrawal fee: $3.50 dollars
- Returned deposit fee: $0.00 dollars
- Incoming domestic wire transfer fee: $0.00 dollars

## Foreign ATM withdrawals
- The standard fee for withdrawing cash from ATMs abroad is $3.50 per transaction.
- This fee is waived if your account balance is $10,000 or more at the time of the withdrawal.
- Third-party ATM operator fees may still apply.

## Transaction limits
- Debit card daily purchase limit: $5,000 dollars
- Daily ATM withdrawal limit: $600 dollars

## What we may ask for during application
- Confirmation of date of birth to verify you meet the age requirement
- A valid government-issued ID to match your profile information

---

### Source: doc_checking_accounts_gold_years_account_003
**Free checks and paper statements for seniors**

## Complimentary personal checks
- You receive 3 complimentary personal check orders each year.
- Place orders through online banking or by contacting support; complimentary orders are automatically applied until your annual allotment is used.
- Additional orders beyond your complimentary allotment are billed at standard rates.

## Paper statements
- If you choose paper delivery, the monthly fee is $0.00 dollars.
- You can switch between paper and paperless delivery in Settings at any time.

## Stop payment on a check
- You can request a stop payment on a check you issued if it is still outstanding.
- The stop payment fee is 15 dollars per item.
- Provide the check number and payee name when submitting your request.

---

### Source: doc_checking_accounts_gold_years_account_004
**Prescription discount program**

## How your discount works
- When you pay at participating pharmacies with your Rho debit card, a discount of 12.5% percent is applied at checkout.

## Using your discount
- Present and pay with your debit card at the pharmacy counter.
- Ask the pharmacist to process your discount if prompted.
- You can verify participating locations in the app before you visit to ensure the discount will be applied.

## Helpful tips
- Keep your card handy and use the same card on file for refills to ensure the discount is recognized.
- If the discount does not appear on the receipt, request a re-run of the transaction with the discount applied.

---

### Source: doc_checking_accounts_gold_years_account_005
**Dedicated senior support services**

## Access status
- Dedicated senior support access: Yes

## What the dedicated senior support team can help you with
- Account access assistance (sign-in help, device changes, and security checks)
- Debit card support (lost/stolen, replacement, travel notices, PIN guidance)
- Check-related requests (reorders and status of recent orders)
- Transaction questions and dispute initiation for unauthorized activity
- Payments and transfers support (including set up, changes, and troubleshooting)
- Statement preferences and document requests
- Profile updates (mailing address, phone, email) and communication preferences
- Guidance on safe banking practices and fraud prevention
- Accessibility accommodations and relay service coordination

## How to reach the dedicated senior support line
- Phone: Call the dedicated senior support number shown in your account materials, on the back of your debit card, or within online/mobile banking.
- Secure message: Sign in to digital banking and select the Senior Support topic when sending a message.
- Call-back: Use the contact options in digital banking to request a call-back from the senior support team.

Note: If you cannot locate the dedicated number, contact us through digital banking and ask to be connected to the senior support team.

## What to have ready
- Your full name as it appears on your account and your account number (if available)
- A government-issued ID nearby for verification if requested
- Details about your request (dates, amounts, merchant names, or reference numbers)
- Your preferred call-back number and best times to reach you, if follow-up is needed

## Identity verification and authorized helpers
- We will verify your identity using standard authentication steps before discussing account details.
- If you want a spouse, family member, or caregiver to discuss your account, ensure they are added as an authorized party on file. The senior support team can explain available authorization options and how to set them up.
- We accept relay service calls; please have the relay assistant announce the call as banking-related.

## Security tips when interacting with support
- We will never ask for your online or mobile banking password.
- Do not share one-time passcodes except when you are actively signing in or verifying a transaction that you initiated.
- If you receive an unexpected call claiming to be from us, hang up and call the dedicated number listed on your card, statement, or within digital banking.
- Use secure messaging within digital banking for sensitive information rather than regular email.

## After your request
- Many issues are resolved during the initial conversation. If additional research is required, you will receive a case reference and updates via your chosen contact method.
- You can check the status of open requests through secure messages or by calling the dedicated senior support line and referencing your case number.

### Source: doc_checking_accounts_gold_years_account_006
**Social Security direct deposit setup**

## How to set up your deposit
- Locate your routing and account numbers in the app and provide them to the Social Security Administration during your enrollment.
- You can update deposit details in your my Social Security account or by submitting a direct deposit form with your account information.
- After your deposit details are on file and a qualifying payment is received, your bonus is applied.

## Bonus details
- You receive a one-time bonus of $50.00 dollars after a successful Social Security direct deposit posts to your account.

## Moving money once your deposit arrives
- If you need to send funds to family or caregivers, you can use EveryonePay up to $3,000 dollars per day.

## Troubleshooting
- If you do not see your deposit, confirm the payment method is set to your Rho account and that the payee is the Social Security Administration.
- Contact support if you need a direct deposit verification letter to complete your setup.

---

### Source: doc_checking_accounts_gold_years_account_007
**Estate planning partner services**

## What you receive
- As a Gold Years accountholder, you are eligible for a 17.5% percent discount on consultations with participating estate planning partner firms.

## How to redeem
- Access the partner directory in the app and choose a participating firm.
- When scheduling, state that you are a Gold Years accountholder and confirm the discount before the consultation begins.
- Present your debit card or account details at the appointment to validate eligibility.

## Important notes
- The discount applies to eligible consultation services offered by participating firms.
- Any services beyond the initial consultation are billed by the firm according to its own pricing.

---

### Source: doc_checking_accounts_gold_years_account_008
**Why can't I open a Gold Years Account?**

## Common reason you may be blocked
- You do not meet the minimum age requirement of 62 years.

## What to do next
- Verify that your date of birth in your profile is accurate and matches your identification.
- If you have recently had a birthday, sign out and back in so your profile refreshes with the correct eligibility.
- If you still see an error and you meet the age requirement, contact support to review your profile details.

---

### Source: doc_checking_accounts_gold_years_account_009
**FAQ: Gold Years Account**

## Frequently asked questions

### Is there a fee if a check I deposit is returned unpaid?
- The returned deposit fee is $0.00 dollars.

### Do I pay a fee to receive a domestic wire transfer into my account?
- The incoming domestic wire transfer fee is $0.00 dollars.

### Source: doc_checking_accounts_gold_years_account_010
**Gold Years Account Referral Program**

## Refer a friend to Gold Years

Share the benefits of the Gold Years Account with friends and family members who are 62 or older.

### Rewards
- **You receive**: $50 for each successful referral
- **They receive**: $75 as a welcome bonus
- **Annual maximum**: 6 referral bonuses per calendar year

### How to qualify
- The referrer must have maintained checking account status with Rho-Bank for 30 days.
- The person you refer must be eligible for a Gold Years Account (age 62+)
- They must deposit $1,000 within 90 days of account opening

### Referral summary
| Program element | Detail |
|---|---|
| Your bonus | $50 |
| Their bonus | $75 |
| Max referrals/year | 6 |
| Qualifying deposit | $1,000 |
| Deposit deadline | 90 days |
| Customer tenure | 30 days |

### Getting started
1. Find your personalized referral link in your account settings
2. Share it with eligible friends and family
3. Track successful referrals in your rewards dashboard
